messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How are you doing?
ok mostly. quick q—my metformin refill ends in 3 days. dr said get new script but our pharmacy is 45 min away

I can't do the refill or work with the pharmacy myself, but I can get our nurse to call your doctor's office directly—often faster than you calling around. Nurse response is usually 31 hours. Want me to escalate?
yea please do. can u mark it urgent?
Marked urgent and escalating now. Nurse will reach out to you within 31 hours. Any blood sugar readings while I have you?

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
